no_adcom_quote.quote: As there were no issues identified that would benefit from an Advisory Committee discussion, an Advisory Committee was not convened to discuss this application.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the TROGARZO (ibalizumab) BLA761065 approval. The Summary Review states the application raised no issues that would benefit from an Advisory Committee discussion, and the Medical Review's section 9 confirms that no advisory committee or other external consultations were held. Because no AdComm meeting occurred, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
